title: mono: rename billingUrl->billingEndpoint in shared-contracts and 3 apps (single PR)

summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and its 3 consumers (core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports) in one mono PR #1; CI and CD green. Assumptions: shared config lives only in mono's inlined lib, so platformkit needed no change (no references); no compatibility alias kept, per acceptance criteria. Local builds of all three apps passed.
